data.name: Henrion
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'Henricus', meaning 'strong ruler, powerful one'. Named after Henry, a Germanic name meaning 'home ruler'. The name Henrion signifies strength, power, and leadership. In Christian tradition, it is associated with St. Henry, a holy Roman Emperor and patron saint of Europe.

data.cultural_impact: Individuals named Henrion were traditionally seen as natural-born leaders, strong in character and capable of guiding others. This reflects the inherent meaning of the name 'Henricus' - strong ruler. Culturally, the name Henrion is believed to impart the qualities of determination, courage, and leadership.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Henrion holds a deep spiritual significance, being derived from St. Henry, the name's patron saint. St. Henry (912-936 AD) was a German-Roman emperor known for his devotion and piety. He played a pivotal role in strengthening the Church's position in the empire, championed the cause of the poor and was known for his just rule. Thus, the name Henrion symbolizes the spiritual qualities of strength, integrity, and true leadership rooted in kindness and compassion.
